description: When a pending PERM case is likely to be decided, with the range, the model and its caveats. Send a case number, or a filing date for a case in analyst review. It's an estimate from DOL's measured pace and makes no promise: show the caveats with the date. Example: {"filed":"2026-02-15"}.

case.description: A PERM case number. Its own status and filing date are used. Example: G-100-26045-123456.

filed.description: A filing date, for a case in analyst review, when there's no case number. Example: 2026-02-15.

name: estimate_decision

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: When a pending PERM case is likely to be decided. An estimate from DOL's own pace: it makes no promise.

basis.description: How the estimate was worked out, in a sentence.

caveats.description: What the estimate can't know. Show them with the date.

anyOf.description: The day DOL decided the case, for the decided kind, as YYYY-MM-DD.

earliest.description: The early end of the range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

estimatedDate.description: The likeliest decision day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

anyOf.description: The filing date the estimate is for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

kind.description: date: an estimated day with a range. no-date: the case is past every model's reach, with a note. none: no model can give a defensible date. decided: the case already has a decision.

latest.description: The late end of the range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

model.description: The model that produced the estimate, by name.

note.description: Why there is no date, for the no-date and none kinds.

pendingCasesAhead.description: Pending PERM cases filed before this one.

status.description: The status the estimate assumed, e.g. ANALYST REVIEW.

waitedDays.description: Days the case has waited, for the no-date kind.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Estimate a PERM decision date
